Author desktop observers caused 80 chat and 80 typing layout reads for 40 updates each; narrowed direct-owner observation fixes both.
Moving desktop editors to body dropped the existing themed text rule (aqua dark showed rgb(8,18,28) instead of white); reuse of the existing text token fixes all eight combinations.
